'''Christina Sormani''' is a professor of mathematics at [[City University of New York]] affiliated with [[Lehman College]] and the [[CUNY Graduate Center]].<ref name=home>{{cite web|url=https://sites.google.com/site/professorsormani/|location=Google sites|title=Professor Sormani|accessdate=Mar 9, 2015}}</ref> She is known for her research in [[Riemannian geometry]], [[metric geometry]], and [[Ricci curvature]], as well as her work on the notion of [[intrinsic flat distance]].<ref>{{cite news|last=Morgan|first=Frank|url=http://www.huffingtonpost.com/frank-morgan/geometry-now-commencement_b_1549248.html|title=Math now--Commencement can wait|newspaper=Huffington Post|date=May 28, 2012|accessdate=Mar 9, 2015}}</ref>

==Career==
Sormani received her Ph.D. from [[New York University]] in 1996 under [[Jeff Cheeger]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=33367|title=Christina Sormani}}</ref> She then took postdoctoral positions at [[Harvard University]] (under [[Shing-Tung Yau]]) and [[Johns Hopkins University]] (under [[William Minicozzi II]]).<ref name= Rutgers>{{cite web|url=http://sciencewomen.rutgers.edu/node/456|title=Eminent Women in Science Seminar: Christina Sormani, PhD|location=[[Rutgers University]]|accessdate=Mar 9, 2015}}</ref> Sormani is now a Full Professor of Mathematics at Lehman College in the City University of New York
and member of the doctoral faculty at the CUNY Graduate Center.<ref name=home/>
<ref>{{cite web |title=Science Faculty Spotlight: Christina Sormani |url=https://www.gc.cuny.edu/news/science-faculty-spotlight-christina-sormani |website=CUNY Graduate Center |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
In 2009, Sormani was an invited speaker at the [[Geometry Festival]].<ref>*[http://www.math.sunysb.edu/geomfest09/ 24th Annual Geometry Festival 2009] in memory of [[Detlef Gromoll]]</ref> She received the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] (AWM) Service Award in 2015. She was recognized for her work planning and coordinating Association for Women in Mathematics activities at the [[Joint Mathematics Meetings]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Association for Women in Mathematics Service Award 2015 |url=https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-service-award/awm-service-award-2015/ |website=Association for Women in Mathematics |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref>

In 2015, Sormani became a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref name=AMS>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref> She was honored for her research in geometry, specifically Ricci curvature. Her mentorship of junior mathematicians from underrepresented groups was also cited in the recognition.<ref>{{cite web |title=Christina Sormani named a 2015 Fellow of the American Mathematical Society |url=https://www.gc.cuny.edu/news/christina-sormani-named-2015-fellow-american-mathematical-society |website=CUNY Graduate Center |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref>

Sormani was selected as an Association for Women in Mathematics Fellow in the Class of 2024 "for utilizing every opportunity to open pathways to mathematics for more women and students by creating and maintaining online access to advice, mathematical resources, and information about women mathematicians; for organizing the “Inspiring Talks by Mathematicians” lecture series featuring under-represented speakers, and for her dedicated and active contributions to the AWM."<ref>{{cite web | title=2024 AWM Fellows | website=Association for Women in Mathematics | url=https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-fellows/2024-awm-fellows/ | ref={{sfnref | Association for Women in Mathematics}} | access-date=2023-10-26}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*Sormani, Christina. (2000). Nonnegative Ricci curvature, small linear diameter growth and finite generation of fundamental groups. ''Journal of Differential Geometry,'' 54(3), pages 547–559. [https://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=1823314 MR 1823314].
*Sormani, Christina, & Wei, Guofang. Hausdorff convergence and universal covers. ''Transactions of the'' ''American Mathematical Society,'' 353 (2001), no. 9, pages 3585–3602. [https://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=1837249 MR 1837249]
*Sormani, Christinam & Wei, Guofang. Universal covers for Hausdorff limits of noncompact spaces. ''Transactions of the'' ''American Mathematical Society,'' 356 (2004), no. 3, pages 1233–1270. [https://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=2021619 MR 2021619]
*Sormani, Christina, & Wenger, Stefan. (2010). Weak convergence of currents and cancellation. ''Calculus of Variations and Partial Differential Equations,'' 38, 183–206. <nowiki>https://doi.org/10.1007/s00526-009-0282-x</nowiki>
*Lee, Dan A, & Sormani, Christina. (2014). Stability of the positive mass theorem for rotationally symmetric Riemannian manifolds. ''Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik'' (''Crelles Journal'') 686. https://doi.org/10.1515/crelle-2012-0094
*Sormani, Christina, & Wenger, Stefan. (2011). The intrinsic flat distance between Riemannian manifolds and other integral current spaces." ''Journal of Differential Geometry,'' 87(1), pages 117–199. [https://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=2786592 MR 2786592]
